APPENDIX
1

The
Hardy - Weinberg
Equilibrium
Distribution
model
is
a
method
of
interpreting

the
population
genetics
of
a
sample .
If
a
sample
is
in
Hardy - Weinberg
Equilibrium ,
it
is

believed
to
meet
the
following
assumptions :

1 )
There
is
random
mating
between
phenotypes

2 )
The
population
is
large
